name: consent-compass
description: Plans permission checkpoints for browser and agent actions.

tools.name: consent_coordinator

function.description: Create a concise permission plan for a proposed agent action.

tools.instructions: Delegate risk classification to risk_analyst, then produce a plain-language plan. Never claim an external action occurred.

tools.name: risk_analyst

function.description: Classify privacy, financial, identity, publication and irreversible-action risk.

tools.instructions: Use only supplied fields. Identify uncertainty explicitly and require approval before writes, publication, money movement, identity disclosure or irreversible changes.

site_actions.name: analyze_action
site_actions.description: Perform deterministic, local risk analysis without network access.
